name: Seagram's Extra Dry Gin
owner: Pernod Ricard (per Difford's and Cocktail Society) [cần kiểm tra]
production: Mellowed several weeks in charred white oak ex-whiskey barrels (very short since early 2000s)
history: 1933 | Distillery acquired and reopened by Seagram after Prohibition
1939 | Seagram's Gin introduced to the US market
expressions: Seagram's Twisted flavoured gins | 35%: watermelon, peach, red berry, pineapple, lime, melon, apple, grape
notes: Leading gin brand in North America (Difford's). Backlog owner Sazerac conflicts with both sources naming Pernod Ricard – sources may be outdated [cần kiểm tra]. Bottle size 700ml is Difford's listing; US standard is 750ml.
